prompts: Create a polished dark fairytale 2D game companion concept presentation board. Use reference1 for existing wolf anatomy: long muzzle, triangular ears, heavy spiky mane, four intact digitigrade legs with large paws, single bushy tail; preserve skeleton-compatible proportions. Reference2 is painting style and Little Red Riding Hood identity only (short ragged red cape ending around hips, brown leather outfit, lantern/scythe); reference3 is the exact riverside cabin battle background to use. The wolf is now her loyal shadow companion, not an enemy. BOTH face RIGHT. No wounds, no gore, no extra limbs, no armor, no generic realistic photograph, no neon effects. Hand-painted ink outlines, textured restrained shading, clear large shapes. Output one landscape 1536x1024 board: left approximately 960x1024 pale parchment studio panel with a large isolated full-body RIGHT-facing wolf, all four paws and tail readable and two small face/paw detail drawings below; right exactly a 9:16 portrait battle concept inset approximately 576x1024. Battle inset preserves reference3 composition and adds Red Hood on left and same wolf just to her right/behind as allies, wolf shoulder at her hip, feet grounded with readable silhouettes, clear empty space to right, no enemies and no HUD. Main character view should have no overlap or cropping. Small top label A/B/C only, no other text. Same framing and scale across variants. This is concept illustration, not a Unity screenshot. Variant A: Charcoal black velvet-like fur, warm grey muzzle and chest highlights, restrained pale lavender eyes, oversized soft paws and alert protective expression. One uncanny feature: mane tips and tail tip fray into a few flat smoky shadow curls, but all joints and body remain solid and readable. Dark violet undertones, silver-grey edge light; NO glowing cracks, NO additional eyes, NO collar. Endearing vigilant watchdog, a fierce companion with quiet supernatural shadow.
